name: antigravity-conversation-tracker
description: Antigravity Conversation Tracker & Inspector - Local developer tool for inspecting Antigravity IDE agent conversations

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT,ELECTRON" -c "blue,magenta,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5200 && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
